tests.name: a Python API + JavaScript UI pair yields a candidate composition hypothesis, never a fact or a claim about the user
three modes, three different behaviours: algorithms, prompts, output schemas, budgets and candidate sets
modes are separate opt-ins and strategic dreaming needs a stated goal
critic: duplicate, trivial, unsupported, already-known and over-certain ideas are rejected, each with a persisted, restart-proof reason
privacy: an agent cannot dream over what it cannot read; a remote model never sees private notes; private-derived ideas are reviewed and kept out of shared indexes
feedback drives status and ranking; rejected ideas do not come back without new evidence; repetition never validates
model failure modes are safe: malformed, refusing, timing-out, unavailable and cancelled providers never write knowledge
no runaway dreaming: discoveries never seed dreams, triggers are rate-limited and deduplicated, and every budget is enforced
deep mode generates sibling candidates from different angles, keeps the best, and records the others as rejected, never as knowledge
deep discoveries must separate facts from speculation, name missing evidence, and cannot present conjecture as a sourced fact
a deep candidate that is repaired once is accepted only if the repaired answer passes the same checks
a contradiction between existing claims is kept as an unresolved deep discovery with one hop and no invented resolution
the evaluation pack has 20+ documents across 5 knowledge domains, contradictions and private notes
configured SQLite vectors add bounded semantic associations to Dream micro retrieval; unavailable backend preserves lexical graph behavior
micro: a local neighbourhood of the changed object plus a few complementary objects from other domains, within a small budget
deep: rare cross-domain bridges, provides/consumes pairs, contradictions and long paths, excluding direct neighbours and unrelated domains
strategic: goal-directed capabilities, competing domains and gaps; a goal nothing supports yields a gap report and no model call
the three modes use different algorithms, budgets and candidate sets; the retrieval trace shows it
retrieval respects authorization: an agent without access to the private workspace never gets its objects into the pool, graph or plan

gaps.item: Independent semantic quality scoring for novelty, feasibility, usefulness, contradictions and hallucinations
